title: Muted Distillation: Sealing Reasoning from Teacher Unlocks Token-Efficient Agents
abstract: arXiv:2611.28445v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: On-policy distillation (OPD) is commonly adopted as one of the components in post-training of large language models (LLMs), but in multi-turn agentic tasks we find that the student model increases their reasoning lengths after training. Our empirical analysis shows that the reasoning token lengths is affected by how much the student can distract the teacher's scores. We introduce Muted Distillation (MD), a simple variant of OPD that hides the student's reasoning from the teacher, so the teacher judges what the student does without the interference of student's reasonings. MD takes a few lines of code and adds no extra data or hyperparameters. On the knowledge-work benchmarks OfficeQA Pro and SpreadsheetBench, it reduces output tokens per episode by 57\% and 53\% compared with standard OPD, making the student more concise than it was before training. At the same time, it matches OPD's accuracy on OfficeQA Pro and improves pass@1 by 4.8 po

translated_title: 静默蒸馏：向教师屏蔽推理过程解锁高效Token智能体
translated_abstract: 在策略蒸馏（OPD）通常被采用为大语言模型（LLM）后训练的组成部分之一，但我们发现在多轮智能体任务中，学生模型在训练后会增加其推理长度。我们的实证分析表明，推理token长度受学生能在多大程度上干扰教师评分的影响。我们提出了静默蒸馏（MD），这是OPD的一个简单变体，它向教师隐藏学生的推理过程，使教师在没有学生推理干扰的情况下评估学生的行为。MD只需几行代码，且无需额外的数据或超参数。在知识工作基准OfficeQA Pro和SpreadsheetBench上，与标准OPD相比，它将每个回合的输出token分别减少了57%和53%，使学生在训练后比训练前更加简洁。同时，它在OfficeQA Pro上保持了与OPD相当的准确率，并将pass@1提升了4.8个点。
tldr: 提出静默蒸馏（MD）方法，通过向教师模型隐藏学生的推理过程，在多轮智能体任务中将输出token减少53-57%的同时保持甚至提升准确率。
en_tdlr: Muted Distillation (MD) hides the student's reasoning from the teacher during on-policy distillation, cutting output tokens by 53-57% while maintaining or improving accuracy in multi-turn agentic tasks.
